items.title: US offers millions for information on Iran’s nuclear program despite Trump’s claims of obliteration
items.brief: The United States is offering a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran’s nuclear program, despite US President Donald Trump’s repeated claims to have obliterated Tehran’s capabilities.

items.title: Schumer faces skepticism among some Democrats over majority leader role
items.brief: Chuck Schumer is confident he’ll continue leading Senate Democrats after they captured the chamber’s majority in dramatic fashion on Tuesday .

items.title: 1 killed, 22 injured after elderly driver suspected to be impaired strikes cyclists in North Carolina, officials say
items.brief: At least one person is dead and 22 others were injured when an elderly driver struck a group of cyclists in Wake County, North Carolina, shortly after 9:30 a.m.

items.title: Despite warnings from Trump admin, after the ‘Blue Wave’ many migrants bound for the US are hopeful

items.title: UFC CEO Dana White declines Trump’s offer to become press secretary, source says
items.brief: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he offered the White House press secretary job to Dana White, but a source familiar with the matter says the Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO declined the unorthodox idea.
